saints.name: St. Ethelbert of Kent
saints.title: King
saints.shortBlurb: The first Christian king among the English, who welcomed St. Augustine of Canterbury and gave the Gospel a home in his realm…
biography: Ethelbert, king of Kent, was the most powerful of the English kings of his day and husband of the Christian Frankish princess Bertha. When St. Augustine and his monks landed in 597, sent by Pope St. Gregory the Great, Ethelbert received them, gave them liberty to preach, and was himself baptized — the first Christian king of the English.

By his favor Canterbury became the see of Augustine and the cradle of the English Church, and he is credited with the earliest written laws in the English tongue. He died in 616 and was long honored as a saint.
saints.knownFor: Receiving St. Augustine of Canterbury and becoming the first Christian English king.

sources.text: Bede, Ecclesiastical History of the English People (public-domain translation)
